dedupe_keys.name: ine sao tome and principe v general population and housing census 2024 results report with households by drinking water source and treatment lighting source reasons for no electricity never connected cut off for non payment outages solid waste and wastewater disposal sanitation housing acquisition construction period and renovation by district plus 2012 census district result pdfs

description: INE, the statistics institute of São Tomé and Príncipe, publishes the results report of the Fifth General Population and Housing Census, taken in 2024 and reported in July 2025, in its documents library. Chapter four covers living and housing conditions with tables by district: drinking water sources and treatment, access to lighting energy, household waste and wastewater disposal, sanitation, household goods, and a housing section on how homes were acquired, their construction period, extension and rehabilitation, and rents. A table on difficulties with electricity reports that of 7,241 dwellings without electricity, 59.4 percent had never been connected and 36.5 percent had been cut off for non-payment, with district shares. The library also holds the 2012 census national results and one results PDF per district. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF, no registration; further tabulations can be requested through a form. Licence: no licence statement was found. Caveats: the 2024 figures are the first results and in Portuguese; no wall or roof material tables were found in the 2024 report. Simulation uses: the split between never-connected and disconnected households by district for electrification and affordability studies, and wastewater disposal for sanitation planning. Related records: the WorldPop GRID3 census-based population grids.
